title: Test Gap: show ip bgp ... commands assume that there's only one container that contains the name bgp
author: lipxu
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the test gap

Need add a new test case to cover the case in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22476


### Affected Area

bgp related show/clear CLI

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

bgp related show/clear CLI return failure

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19475
`show ip bgp ...` commands should not assume that there's only one container that contains the name bgp
Add a new testcase to prevent regression.

Tested an old image without below fix:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/3947

Test failed with error message:
```
FAILED bgp/test_bgp_command.py::test_bgp_commands_with_like_bgp_container[sonic-ipv4] - Failed: BGP command failed with 'No such command' error when like-bgp container is present. Error: Usage: show ip [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
FAILED bgp/test_bgp_command.py::test_bgp_commands_with_like_bgp_container[sonic-ipv6] - Failed: BGP command failed with 'No such command' error when like-bgp container is present. Error: Usage: show ipv6 [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Test an newer image with this fix, and test passed.
